title: Incrementing a Run of Ones
statement: For every natural number $p$ and optional Boolean list $T$, incrementing the word formed by $p$ true bits followed by a false bit and then the list in $T$ yields, if $T$ is present, the word of $p$ false bits followed by a true bit and that list; if $T$ is absent, the increment result is absent.
